grammarFocus: 过去进行时入门；when / while；who / which / that 定语从句入门。
title: A Lantern Festival Story
instructions: 本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。请先听录音（或阅读录音稿），然后完成10道题。题目包括单选、填空和判断正误/未提及。填空答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。所有解释均为中文。
transcript: Last year, I went to a small town for the Lantern Festival. My friend Mei was waiting for me at the station. While we were walking to her home, she told me about a man who makes lanterns. His name is Mr. Chen. He is a craftsman who has made lanterns for forty years. When we arrived, Mr. Chen was working in his small shop. He was cutting bamboo into thin pieces. "I was learning this from my father when I was ten," he said. "While I was cutting, I made many mistakes." Mei asked him, "Who is the person that taught you the most?" He smiled and said, "My father, of course. He was very patient." Then Mr. Chen showed us a beautiful lantern that he was making. It was a rabbit lantern. "I was making this for my granddaughter," he said. "She loves rabbits." While we were talking, a little girl came in. She was Mr. Chen's granddaughter. She was carrying a small gift for her grandfather. It was a red envelope. "Thank you, sweetheart," Mr. Chen said. He looked very happy. Then he gave me a small lantern. "This is for you," he said. "It is a gift that brings good luck." I was very thankful. While we were leaving, I thought about Mr. Chen. He is a man who loves his family and his work. That day, I learned that traditions are important. They connect people who care about each other.

grammar.title: 过去进行时与定语从句入门
grammar.explanation: 过去进行时表示过去某个时刻正在进行的动作，结构是 was/were + 动词-ing。常与 when 或 while 连用：when 后常接短暂动作（一般过去时），while 后常接持续动作（过去进行时）。定语从句用来修饰名词，who 指人，which 指物，that 可指人或物。
grammar.example: When we arrived, Mr. Chen was working in his small shop.

options: While she was cooking, the phone rang.
While she was cooking, the phone was ringing.
While she cooked, the phone was ringing.
While she cooks, the phone rang.
answers: While she was cooking, the phone rang.
questions.explanation: while 引导持续动作，用过去进行时；电话响是短暂动作，用一般过去时。选项A正确。选项B两个持续动作，但电话响通常视为短暂动作，且与while搭配不自然；选项C时态不一致；选项D时态错误。
questions.evidence: While we were walking to her home, she told me about a man who makes lanterns.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a relative clause.
options: The man who is talking is my uncle.
The man which is talking is my uncle.
The man who talking is my uncle.
The man what is talking is my uncle.
answers: The man who is talking is my uncle.
questions.explanation: 指人用 who，且从句需要谓语动词 is talking。选项A正确。选项B which 指物；选项C缺少 is；选项D what 不能这样用。
questions.evidence: He is a craftsman who has made lanterns for forty years.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a relative clause.
options: The book that I bought is interesting.
The book who I bought is interesting.
The book which I bought it is interesting.
The book what I bought is interesting.
answers: The book that I bought is interesting.
questions.explanation: 指物可用 that，且从句中不再用 it。选项A正确。选项B who 指人；选项C多了 it；选项D what 不能这样用。
questions.evidence: It is a gift that brings good luck.

options: I was walking home when I saw a dog.
I walked home when I was seeing a dog.
I was walking home when I was seeing a dog.
I walk home when I saw a dog.
answers: I was walking home when I saw a dog.
questions.explanation: when 后接短暂动作 saw，主句用过去进行时 was walking。选项A正确。选项B was seeing 不自然；选项C两个进行时搭配不当；选项D时态错误。
questions.evidence: When we arrived, Mr. Chen was working in his small shop.
